title.zh-CN: 更稳定的后台更新与更顺手的进程和空间操作
title.en: More reliable background updates and smoother process and storage workflows

items.zh-CN: 进程页新增端口搜索与实时排序开关；关闭实时排序后，列表会保持单次排序结果，查看或操作进程时不再因采样更新不断跳动。
items.en: The process page now supports port search and a live sorting toggle. With live sorting off, the list keeps its one-time order so rows no longer jump while you inspect or manage a process.

items.zh-CN: 空间清理统一了结果卡片宽度和间距，路径支持逐级点击返回；存储页的最高占用可直接进入清理，长期未使用应用则集中到应用页查看。
items.en: Space cleanup now uses consistent result-card sizing and spacing, with clickable path segments for moving back through folders. The highest-storage item opens cleanup directly, while long-unused apps are now grouped in the Applications area.

items.zh-CN: 应用更新在隐藏主窗口或重新载入界面后会继续下载、校验和安装；重新打开会接回同一进度，传输失败时可直接重试。
items.en: App updates now keep downloading, verifying, and installing when the main window is hidden or reloaded. Reopening the window reconnects to the same progress, and failed transfers can be retried directly.

title.zh-CN: 更可靠的长时间空间扫描

items.zh-CN: 空间扫描在个别文件夹长时间无响应时会自动恢复并继续检查其他内容，保留已经完成的进度；无需一直停留在应用前台或手动重新扫描，恢复过程中仍可随时停止。
items.en: Space scans now recover automatically when an individual folder remains unresponsive, keep completed progress, and continue checking other content; you no longer need to keep CoreRobin in the foreground or restart the scan manually, and can still stop at any time.

title.zh-CN: 更可靠的空间扫描与更完整的历史回顾
title.en: More reliable space scans and richer history reviews

items.zh-CN: 长时间空间扫描现在可以在切换页面、隐藏窗口或重新载入界面后继续显示同一任务；电脑休眠后能够恢复，停止扫描后也可以立即重新开始。
items.en: Long-running space scans now remain connected when you switch pages, hide the window, or reload the interface; they recover after sleep and can be restarted immediately after stopping.

items.zh-CN: 关闭主窗口后，必要的本机状态观察和提醒仍会继续；当数据暂停、过期或暂时不可用时，主窗口、状态栏和 Robin 会明确显示当前状态。
items.en: Essential local monitoring and alerts now continue after the main window closes, while the main window, menu bar, and Robin clearly identify paused, stale, or temporarily unavailable data.

items.zh-CN: 资源、存储、网络和应用影响历史改用真实时间轴，能够保留休眠与采样中断造成的缺口，并查看应用影响的峰值时段与当时排名。
items.en: Resource, storage, network, and application-impact history now uses real time, preserves gaps caused by sleep or interrupted sampling, and shows peak periods with the application ranking at that time.

items.zh-CN: 回顾页面新增今天、昨天和过去七天的对比以及可选的本机每周提醒；清理、卸载、进程、启动项、卷推出和应用更新也会记录操作后的实际结果。
items.en: Reviews now compare today, yesterday, and the past seven days with an optional local weekly reminder, while cleanup, uninstall, process, startup-item, volume-eject, and update actions record their observed results.

items.zh-CN: 历史数据可以按时间范围和指标导出为 CSV 或 JSON；导出前会显示隐私预览，默认不包含应用名称、命令行、完整路径或连接地址。
items.en: History can now be exported as CSV or JSON by time range and metric, with a privacy preview that excludes application names, command lines, full paths, and connection addresses by default.

items.zh-CN: Windows 和 Linux 的进程操作预览新增请求结束、强制结束与安全重启，并在目标已经变化、没有可关闭窗口或权限不足时给出明确说明。
items.en: The Windows and Linux process-control preview now supports request close, force stop, and safe restart, with clear explanations when the target changed, has no closable window, or requires additional permission.

title.zh-CN: 更顺畅的操作确认与状态反馈
title.en: Smoother confirmations and clearer progress feedback

items.zh-CN: 启动项和进程操作不再因确认窗口停留较久而要求重新开始；最终确认时会自动刷新当前操作状态。
items.en: Startup-item and process actions no longer force you to start over after leaving a confirmation open; the action state is refreshed automatically when you confirm.

items.zh-CN: 日常与专业模式切换会保持当前位置，当前模式不会重复触发跳转；界面、语言和外观设置也集中到同一入口。
items.en: Switching between Everyday and Professional modes now preserves your context, while interface, language, and appearance settings are grouped in one place.

items.zh-CN: 检查更新、下载、安装、扫描和重新载入等进行中状态现在使用统一的动态反馈，更新完成提示也会自动收起。
items.en: Update checks, downloads, installation, scans, and reloads now use consistent animated progress feedback, and completed-update notices collapse automatically.

items.zh-CN: 启动影响空状态可直接启用登录时启动，进程、网络和应用说明也改为更容易理解的表达。
items.en: The startup-impact empty state can now enable launch at login directly, and process, network, and application explanations use clearer language.

items.zh-CN: 精简重复的采样说明，并改善历史与设备状态区域的间距、高度和内容布局。
items.en: Redundant sampling labels have been removed, with improved spacing, sizing, and content layout across history and device-status sections.

title.zh-CN: 主动更新、今日回顾与更顺畅的日常操作
title.en: Proactive updates, daily review, and smoother everyday actions

items.zh-CN: 新版本会通过非阻塞卡片提示，可立即更新、24 小时后提醒或仅跳过当前版本，并在安装后直接重启。
items.en: New releases now appear in a non-blocking card with options to update now, remind in 24 hours, or skip only that version, followed by an in-app restart.

items.zh-CN: 日常模式新增“今日回顾”，汇总当天事件、恢复、网络异常与操作结果，并只在证据充分时描述观察到的变化。
items.en: Everyday mode gains a Today review that summarizes incidents, recoveries, network events, and action results while reporting observed changes only when evidence is sufficient.

items.zh-CN: Robin 现在可以双击或通过菜单打开主窗口，自动休眠建议中的阻止应用也可直接点击查看对应进程。
items.en: Robin can now open the main window by double-click or menu, and apps blocking automatic sleep can be opened directly in the process view.

items.zh-CN: 专业模式左上角品牌和文件位置等操作文案更加清晰，减少难懂的技术表达。
items.en: Professional-mode branding and file-location actions now use clearer, less technical wording.

title.zh-CN: 持续历史、事件回放与更完整的操作闭环
title.en: Continuous history, event replay, and complete action loops

items.zh-CN: 原生后台采样器在主窗口关闭后仍会保持状态栏、提醒和已启用历史的连续性，并用有界的私有分段存储可靠保存数据。
items.en: The native background sampler keeps menu-bar status, alerts, and enabled histories continuous after the main window closes, with bounded private segments for reliable storage.

items.zh-CN: 新增系统事件回放、电池使用会话、连接详情和应用影响归因，可在同一时间轴中解释资源峰值、网络异常和操作后的变化。
items.en: System event replay, battery sessions, connection details, and application attribution now explain resource peaks, network incidents, and post-action changes on a shared timeline.

items.zh-CN: 空间扫描增加最近三次增长快照，清理回执区分逻辑大小、物理占用和实际可用空间变化，并支持失败项重试。
items.en: Space scans now retain three growth snapshots, while cleanup receipts distinguish logical size, physical usage, and actual free-space changes with retries for failed items.

items.zh-CN: 启动项增加责任应用与签名归属，应用卸载加入筛选和废纸篓残留检查，设置与关注规则支持安全预览、导入和导出。
items.en: Startup items gain responsible-app and signature ownership, uninstall gains filters and optional Trash leftover checks, and settings plus watch rules can be safely previewed, imported, and exported.

items.zh-CN: 应用更新成为全局任务，并优化存储页、磁盘吞吐图和日常/专业模式切换的布局、响应式样式与多语言短标签。
items.en: App updates now run as a global task, with improved storage layouts, disk-throughput charts, and responsive multilingual Daily/Pro mode controls.

title.zh-CN: 更顺畅的空间清理与应用内更新

items.zh-CN: 扇形空间图检测到内容变化后，可以只刷新当前文件夹，无需重新扫描整个磁盘。
items.en: When disk-map contents change, CoreRobin can refresh only the current folder instead of rescanning the entire disk.

items.zh-CN: 清理篮采用更直观的检查与删除文案；更新安装完成后可以直接重新启动 CoreRobin。
items.en: Cleanup actions now use clearer review and delete wording, and CoreRobin can restart directly after an update is installed.

items.zh-CN: 普通应用数据、隐藏配置目录和用户明确选择的同磁盘目录可以进入检查与清理流程，不再被一概拦截。
items.en: Ordinary app data, hidden configuration folders, and explicitly selected same-disk folders can now enter the review and cleanup workflow instead of being blocked wholesale.

items.zh-CN: 凭据、系统根目录、其他用户数据、符号链接和跨文件系统边界继续受到保护，并同步更新 10 种界面语言和中英文文档。
items.en: Credentials, system roots, other users' data, symlinks, and filesystem boundaries remain protected, with all 10 interface languages and English/Chinese documentation updated accordingly.

title.zh-CN: 更可信的历史归因与跨平台系统操作
title.en: More trustworthy history and platform operations

items.zh-CN: 应用影响历史迁移到原生私有存储，采用紧凑格式与原子写入，并显示最后成功保存时间、空间占用和失败原因。
items.en: Application-impact history moves to compact, atomic native private storage and reports its last successful save, storage use, and persistence failures.

items.zh-CN: 新增可点选的应用影响时间轴、峰值时段排名和自然语言解释；历史异常可以直接定位到当时主要占用资源的应用。
items.en: A selectable application-impact timeline, peak-period ranking, and plain-language explanation connect historical incidents to the apps active at that time.

items.zh-CN: 个性化基线要求多个独立日期并展示覆盖度；启动项变更回执采用观察性表达，多项变更不再错误归因给单个应用。
items.en: Personal baselines now require multiple distinct days and show coverage, while startup-change receipts avoid causal claims and single-app attribution after multiple changes.

items.zh-CN: 磁盘健康检查加入超时、有限并发、卷级缓存和单卷重试；Windows/Linux 卸载使用清单指纹缓存、定向包核对和批量 RPM 归属查询。
items.en: Disk-health checks gain watchdogs, bounded concurrency, per-volume caching, and isolated retry. Windows and Linux uninstall use inventory fingerprints, targeted package validation, and batched RPM ownership queries.

items.zh-CN: 更新跨平台真实设备验收清单、10 种界面语言及中英文公开文档，并新增高可见功能区的翻译质量门禁。
items.en: Cross-platform device acceptance, all 10 interface languages, and English/Chinese public documentation are updated with a new translation-quality gate for high-visibility features.

title.zh-CN: 更完整的桌面监控与更顺畅的系统操作
title.en: More complete desktop monitoring and smoother system actions

items.zh-CN: 新增数据与隐私中心和交互式首次使用引导，集中说明本机数据、历史记录、通知与系统权限，并提供对应管理入口。
items.en: A new Data & Privacy Center and interactive onboarding explain local data, history, notifications, and system permissions with direct management actions.

items.zh-CN: 网络质量诊断扩展为六阶段检查和最近 15 分钟趋势，可区分 DNS、IPv4/IPv6、联网探测与多目标连接状态，并展示延迟、抖动和异常变化。
items.en: Network quality now provides a six-stage diagnosis and a 15-minute trend across DNS, IPv4/IPv6, connectivity probes, multiple targets, latency, jitter, and anomalies.

items.zh-CN: 应用关注规则新增跨页面历史时间线；系统监控、提醒和更新状态在主窗口、日常模式与状态栏界面之间保持一致。
items.en: Application watch rules gain a persistent history timeline, while monitoring, alerts, and update state remain consistent across the main window, Daily mode, and the menu bar.

items.zh-CN: 日常/专业模式切换移到稳定位置，日常概览补充粗略磁盘空间；可移除卷可以直接弹出，进程操作和文件路径操作也更加紧凑可靠。
items.en: Daily and Professional switching now stays in a stable location, Daily overview includes disk usage, removable volumes can be ejected directly, and process and path actions are more compact and reliable.

items.zh-CN: 空间清理复用已扫描目录明细和缓存，缺失项目不会阻止其余内容；受控临时目录中的当前用户普通文件可以清理，同时继续保护敏感位置。
items.en: Cleanup reuses scanned folder details and cache, skips missing items without blocking the rest, and allows ordinary user-owned content in approved temporary locations while protecting sensitive boundaries.

items.zh-CN: 更新 10 种应用语言及中英文用户指南和隐私说明，并改善通知权限、系统设置和操作失败后的恢复入口。
items.en: All 10 app languages plus the English and Chinese guides and privacy documentation are updated, with clearer recovery paths for permission, settings, and action failures.

title.zh-CN: 更顺畅的清理与可靠的后台监控
title.en: Smoother cleanup and reliable background monitoring

items.zh-CN: 清理篮不再重复核对整批路径：存在的内容会继续处理，已经不存在或暂时不可访问的内容会跳过并在结果中说明，不会阻止其他项目。
items.en: Cleanup no longer revalidates the entire basket. Available items continue to be processed, while missing or temporarily unavailable items are skipped and reported without blocking the rest.

items.zh-CN: 关闭主窗口后，系统资源采样、提醒规则、历史快照与网络连接历史会继续运行；重新打开窗口时可以看到连续数据。
items.en: System sampling, alert rules, history snapshots, and network connection history now keep running after the main window is closed, preserving continuity when it is reopened.

items.zh-CN: 文件洞察扫描会跨页面继续执行并保留进度；空间清理结果可直接进入对应路径、查看大文件或加入清理篮，减少重复扫描和绕路操作。
items.en: File insight scans now continue across navigation and preserve progress. Cleanup results can open the matching path, show large files, or add items to the basket directly.

items.zh-CN: 精简废纸篓、永久删除、进程和启动项操作的确认流程；永久删除仍保留不可恢复确认，其他可恢复操作不再重复确认。
items.en: Confirmation flows for Trash, permanent deletion, processes, and startup items are shorter. Irreversible deletion keeps its explicit safeguard, while recoverable actions avoid duplicate prompts.

items.zh-CN: 设置、网络质量和日常模式经过重新整理，并加入每日缓存的更新检查、跨页面会话数据以及更明确的失败恢复入口。
items.en: Settings, network quality, and Daily mode are reorganized with a daily cached update check, session data that survives navigation, and clearer recovery actions.

title.zh-CN: 更快的清理与更清楚的应用卸载
title.en: Faster cleanup and clearer app removal

items.zh-CN: 清理确认不再在 60 秒后失效；在废纸篓与永久删除之间切换会复用已核对的信息，同时仍在执行前再次检查每个路径。
items.en: Cleanup confirmations no longer expire after 60 seconds. Switching between Trash and permanent deletion reuses verified file details while every path is still checked again before execution.

items.zh-CN: “较小对象”现在可以展开并逐项检查；完整扫描和后续展开得到的大目录明细会被缓存，再次进入时立即显示，仅在路径变化后后台刷新。前后端缓存版本也已对齐，保存的扫描结果可以正常恢复。
items.en: Smaller objects can now be expanded and reviewed. Large-folder details captured during the full scan and later folder expansions are cached, shown immediately on return, and refreshed in the background only when the path changes. Saved cleanup scans now restore correctly across the frontend and backend cache.

items.zh-CN: 没有可验证 Bundle ID 的 macOS 应用也可以只卸载经过验证的应用本体；已移除应用会保留在列表中并显示废纸篓或永久删除状态，不再强制重扫完整应用清单。
items.en: macOS apps without a verifiable Bundle ID can still be removed safely as an exact app-bundle-only operation. Removed apps stay visible with clear Trash or permanent-deletion status instead of forcing another full inventory scan.

items.zh-CN: 关闭主窗口后，点击 macOS Dock 图标现在会重新打开主窗口。
items.en: Clicking the macOS Dock icon now reopens the main window after it has been closed.

title.zh-CN: 网络趋势与日常体验完善

items.zh-CN: 打开网络质量页会自动检查，页面停留期间每 30 秒采样，展示最近 15 分钟的延迟、抖动和丢包趋势。
items.en: Network quality checks automatically when the page opens and samples every 30 seconds while it remains visible, showing recent 15-minute latency, jitter, and loss trends.

items.zh-CN: 首次扫描前，清理页会展示只读范围和明确的开始按钮。移到废纸篓仍是可恢复的默认方式，直接删除需要单独确认。
items.en: Before the first scan, Cleanup shows its read-only scope and a clear start button. Moving to Trash remains the recoverable default, with a separate confirmation for direct deletion.

items.zh-CN: 设置现在使用一致的卡片布局与控件。专业模式默认选择有用的进程，应用关注规则也改用统一的应用、指标、阈值和持续时间字段。
items.en: Settings now uses consistent card layouts and controls. Professional mode selects a useful process by default, and app watch rules use styled app, metric, threshold, and duration fields.

items.zh-CN: macOS DMG 已使用 Developer ID 签名、经过 Apple 公证、装订票据并通过 Gatekeeper 校验。Apple Silicon 已完成实机验证；Intel 已通过自动校验，但仍待独立实机验收。
items.en: macOS DMGs are Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper-validated. Apple Silicon is hardware-tested; Intel has passed automated validation but awaits separate hardware acceptance.

title.zh-CN: 彻底卸载与真实应用身份
title.en: Complete uninstall and authentic app identity

items.zh-CN: 应用成为两种模式中的一级入口，显示本地化名称和真实图标，复用缓存清单，并在 macOS 上提供逐路径复核的彻底卸载助手。
items.en: Apps is a top-level entry in both modes. It shows localized app names and real icons, reuses a cached inventory, and opens the Complete Uninstall Assistant for path-by-path review on macOS.

title.zh-CN: 安装可靠性与空间扫描体验修复
title.en: Install reliability and space-scan experience fixes

items.zh-CN: 修复 Apple Silicon DMG 中应用包签名不完整、可能被 macOS 判定为已损坏的问题。
items.en: Fixed an incomplete app-bundle signature in the Apple Silicon DMG that could make macOS report the app as damaged.

items.zh-CN: 发布前会重新挂载 DMG，检查应用签名、资源封装和目标架构。
items.en: Release validation now remounts the DMG and checks its complete signature, resource seal, and target architecture.

items.zh-CN: 恢复空间扫描的彩色轨道、扫描扇区、呼吸光晕与节点脉冲。
items.en: Restored colored tracks, scan sectors, breathing glow, and node pulses during a space scan.

items.zh-CN: 修正状态栏缩略面板的高度，并让较小屏幕可以滚动查看完整内容。
items.en: Adjusted the menu bar panel height and added small-screen scrolling fallback.

items.zh-CN: Apple Silicon Mac 临时运行 Intel 包时也能读取电池健康度；如需读取温度，仍建议使用原生包。
items.en: Apple Silicon Macs can recover battery health even when temporarily running the Intel package; the native package remains recommended for temperature readings.

items.zh-CN: 下载页现在会分别说明操作系统推荐和 Mac 芯片选择，也区分“无法验证开发者”与“应用已损坏”两类提示。
items.en: The download page now separates OS recommendation from Mac chip choice and explains both macOS launch-warning cases.
